figurative_meaning_en: Market for vegetables, fish, and meat
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজ সকালে কাঁচাবাজারে গিয়ে তাজা মাছ কিনলাম।
কাঁচাবাজারের দামগুলো এখন অনেক বেড়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I went to the wet market this morning and bought fresh fish.
The prices in the fresh produce market have gone up a lot now.
note: This term is commonly used in Bengali-speaking regions to refer to traditional markets for uncooked food items, reflecting everyday commerce.
